author: Zeldafan420
quote: Rockstar somehow managed to make us wait over a decade for a game, and at this point I’ve experienced more character development in real life than GTA has had in its entire development cycle. I’ve graduated, paid taxes, worked multiple jobs, and gone through several stages of adulthood waiting for this thing. The marketing is incredible, but the constant delays and endless hype have become ridiculous. At this rate, GTA 7 will be announced at my funeral. 0/10 until proven otherwise.
